   \]
   This can be rewritten using the geometric series sum formula:
   \[
   F(x) = \prod_{k=1}^n \frac{1 - x^k}{1 - x} = \frac{1}{(1 - x)^n} \prod_{k=1}^n (1 - x^k)
   \]
